description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of the Git pager mechanism, including configurations, environmental effects, and command behaviors related to paging output. It contains test setup, assertions, and helper functions specific to testing the paging subsystem within Git.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine expected test outcome and command setup, managing variables for test expectations and full command execution.

methods.name: test_default_pager
methods.description: Verifies that the default pager is used when no other pager configuration overrides it.

methods.name: test_PAGER_overrides
methods.description: Checks whether the PAGER environment variable overrides the default pager behavior.

methods.name: test_core_pager_overrides
methods.description: Tests repository local core.pager configuration overriding default pager settings.

methods.name: test_local_config_ignored
methods.description: Ensures that local configurations are ignored when specific conditions are met, e.g., when configurations are forcibly disabled.

methods.name: test_core_pager
methods.description: Runs the core.pager configuration test with various conditions, including local config and environment override.

methods.name: test_core_pager_subdir
methods.description: Tests whether core.pager configuration in subdirectories is correctly respected or ignored based on settings.

methods.name: test_no_local_config_subdir
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no local config is present in subdirectories.

methods.name: test_pager_subdir_helper
methods.description: Helper for testing pager configuration inheritance and overrides from subdirectory contexts.

methods.name: test_GIT_PAGER_overrides
methods.description: Verifies that GIT_PAGER environment variable overrides core.pager settings.

methods.name: test_doesnt_paginate
methods.description: Confirms that certain commands do not invoke pager even if configured to do so.

methods.name: test_pager_choices
methods.description: Runs various tests to verify pager behavior under different configuration and environment scenarios.
